intent_snapshot.goal: Repair PR #581 (imm/unified-lane-sessions at 47786714; Spec docs/specs/unified-lane-sessions.spec.md, #570) before merge, per the verified review of 2026-11-20. Fix: N1 the Loop daemon drive job fails a running Lane instead of calling advanceLanes every tick (agent_handlers.ts:1172-1183 returns failed on 'lane running'; Spec D15/LDP-A1); N2 resume never clears session.attention (child_session_reconciler.ts:166); Must 1 find-adoption of a write-ahead key forces entry_submitted true (child_session_reconciler.ts:132-135); Must 2 a single open refusal parks needs_human and daemon re-entry auto-clears it with now() (batch_lanes.ts:1059,1673; agent_handlers.ts:1142) — decided: keep enrolled, retry next advance, park on the second consecutive refusal, never auto-clear by confirmation time, amend Spec D10; Must 3 a rejected port.stop still parks lane_executor_stopped (host-core/runtime.ts:1166, lane_decision.ts:139); Must 4 mid-run blocked never writes attention so holdOf misses it (child_session_reconciler.ts:159, drive_dispatcher.ts:275-278); Should 3 SessionPortAdapter.send turns pane_not_found into ok (session_port_adapter.ts:98); Should 4 an exited child with a pending correction falls into the stall path (child_session_reconciler.ts:290); Should 5 observeLanes never returns ask_user while a sibling works (lane_sessions/index.ts:424-436). Restore session_providers default ["herdr"] (Spec D9, decision Q1) and add a major changeset (decision Q5). Keep the plugins/immune-brain and plugins/immune-brain-antigravity runtime mirrors and derived bundles in sync. Out of scope (tracked in #582): extracting the triplicated rotation open, the comment-only if, defaultAgreementPolicies removal condition, any/as never cleanup, lane_decision plan_source guard, stop-path native gate, and #580.

acceptance.assertion: Claude and Antigravity derived plugin outputs are in sync with plugins/immune-brain/runtime (bun scripts/build-claude-plugin.ts --check and the Antigravity build check both pass), so the two plugin mirrors carry every repair.

Child session reconciler (review Must 1, Must 4, N2, Should 4, Q2): (a) a write-ahead key whose open crashed is adopted through find by restoring only the handle — the recorded entry_submitted stays false and, observed idle or done, the reconciler resumes the entry; (b) an observed mid-run blocked writes the observation into session.attention, and the next non-blocked observation or a successful resume clears attention to null; (c) an observed exited child with an unprocessed coordinator correction rotates to the next generation whose entry is the correction text, marks that correction processed, and leaves no_progress unchanged; (d) a provider open refusal keeps the child enrolled with handle null and the refusal reason in the report, the next advance retries find then open on the same provider, and only a second consecutive refusal parks the child needs_human with lane_session_open_rejected; the old immediate-park assertion in tests/batch-session-port.test.ts is rewritten, not deleted. Each case is a new or updated test in tests/batch-session-port.test.ts using a fake port.

Session port adapter and observeLanes (review Should 3, Should 5): SessionPortAdapter.send returns a refusal when the provider reports pane_not_found, so the reconciler leaves that instruction digest unprocessed for the next tick; observe keeps mapping pane_not_found to exited. observeLanes returns next_action ask_user when any interactive_host child is stalled_idle while a sibling is still working, but returns advance when a sibling has exited, settled, or awaits a decision. Covered by new cases in tests/lane-sessions.test.ts.

Single-child stop (review Must 3): when BatchSessionPort.stop rejects, both the host-core runtime path and the lane_decision relay path leave the child enrolled (not lane_executor_stopped), report the provider code and reason, and keep the session reconciled on the next advance; a successful stop still parks lane_executor_stopped and retains the Lane. Covered in tests/single-task-lane-decision.test.ts.

Loop daemon drive job (review N1, Must 4, Q2): while its Lane is running with no dialog the drive job does not fail and calls the drive (advanceLanes) again at the retry interval until the Lane settles, a dialog hold escalates, or the job's runtime limit is reached; no lane-running escalation is posted. A mid-run blocked child (attention set) escalates lane_entry_blocked once via planEscalation. A child parked needs_human after a second open refusal is not auto-resumed by a daemon re-entry that passes now() as confirmation_time; it escalates instead. Covered by new cases in tests/loop-daemon-agent-handlers.test.ts whose fake drive reports lane running for at least one call before settling.

Daemon drive dispatcher integration (review N1, Must 4): with a real v3 Batch Record and fake port, a mid-run blocked child surfaces as hold_for_dialog with its attention detail, and an unchanged running child surfaces as not settled and not held so the job keeps advancing. Covered in tests/loop-daemon-drive-pr.test.ts; existing async-drive scheduling tests still pass.

session_providers defaults to ["herdr"] (decision Q1, Spec D9) in layered_config, host-core runtime, drive_dispatcher, v4_runtime and the migrate hint; docs/reference/immune-brain-config.md states ["herdr"] consistently; outside Herdr with no configuration the refusal lists only the herdr recovery. tests/layered-config.test.ts asserts the default.

Spec D10 in docs/specs/unified-lane-sessions.spec.md is amended (decision Q2): an open refusal keeps the child enrolled and retries on the same provider at the next advance, and a second consecutive refusal parks it needs_human; daemon re-entry never clears needs_human by confirmation time alone.
A .changeset entry declares "immune-brain": major for the unified-lane-sessions release (decision Q5: v2 records refused, herdr key retired, daemon regression outside Herdr).

attestations.summary: Round-3 delta replaces the record.confirmation.source==='native_gate' proxy with an explicit literal_user_confirmation input set by HostRuntime only when batch_preflight required a fresh gate (reuse_authorization false, which needs_human batches always hit via batch_not_running), threaded through advanceLanes into runLaneBatchEngine and mirrored in both dist bundles, so daemon re-entry with a newer confirmation_time no longer clears a lane_session_open_rejected park (rr-6/rr-9), pinned by a new batch-session-port test and a host-stop-rejection test for rr-5; blast radius medium: unattended/batch_lanes.ts resume authority, lane_sessions/index.ts, host-core/runtime.ts, no persisted-shape change.

findings.summary: A first open refusal during correction rotation drops the correction: the write-ahead session already marks the correction digest handled, and the D10 retry on the next advance opens g(n+1) with the default entry instead of the correction text.

evidence.trigger: Child idle/done/exited with an unprocessed coordinator correction; port.closeWithProof succeeds and port.open(nextKey, entry: correction.text) refuses once → refusedOpen returns open_refused with handle null, handled_interventions already containing the correction digest. Next advance: !session.handle → find(nextKey) not_found → port.open({key: nextKey, entry}) where entry is 'drive <task>' → the generation opens without the correction, and because the digest is handled the correction is never re-delivered. The old code parked immediately, so this silent loss is new with the rr-3(d) retry. No test covers a refused open on the correction rotation.

findings.summary: The drive job now retries every unsettled, non-held, non-parked drive result for up to 6 hours, including permanent refusals (authorizeBatch refusal, startLanes/advanceLanes lane_session_unavailable), not only a Lane that is actually running.

evidence.trigger: Daemon enroll_and_drive outside Herdr (the D18 accepted regression), or with an agreement that authorizeBatch refuses → dispatchLoopDrive returns {settled:false, hold_for_dialog:null, parked:null, reason:'lane_session_unavailable ...'} → the new `while (!driven.settled)` loop in agent_handlers.ts sleeps IMM_LOOP_DIALOG_RETRY_MS and re-drives until LANE_DRIVE_MAX_MS (6h). The job keeps its lease, posts no escalation, and fails only at the deadline instead of failing at once with the refusal reason as it did before. rr-6 scopes the retry to 'while its Lane is running with no dialog'. The drive result has no field that tells a running Lane apart from a refusal, and no test pins the refusal case.

findings.summary: The host-core start_unattended_batch stop path's new rejected-stop branch (runtime.ts:1166-1170) has no test; the only new rr-5 test drives the lane_decision relay path via h.relay("stop"), and stop:true is called only in teardown, where errors are swallowed.

evidence.trigger: single-task Lane, then start_unattended_batch {task_id, stop:true} while BatchSessionPort.stop returns {ok:false} → the delivered tests never assert the result (blocked lane_stop_rejected with code/reason, child still enrolled, Lane retained), so a regression back to parking lane_executor_stopped would still pass rr-5 even though rr-5 names both paths

findings.summary: The batch_lanes gate that blocks re-entry from clearing lane_session_open_rejected reads the record's fixed creation-time record.confirmation.source, not the authority of the re-entry, and no test exercises it, so for a daemon batch a literal user can never resume the child.

evidence.trigger: Daemon-authorized v3 batch (confirmation.source tracker_approval, set at drive_dispatcher.ts:146) whose child is parked lane_session_open_rejected after a second refusal. A literal user re-enters through native-gated start_unattended_batch (host-core/runtime.ts:1500-1512, confirmation_time now). advanceLanes forwards the persisted confirmation (lane_sessions/index.ts:310), so literalUser stays false at batch_lanes.ts:1077. Result: the child stays needs_human forever, and the 'a literal-user confirmation must resume it' recovery the daemon escalates (agent_handlers.ts) cannot be reached. For a native_gate-created batch the reverse holds: any fresher confirmation_time clears the park. Neither branch is tested; the rr-6 test only fakes drive().parked in the handler.
